summary: Iteration 9 tested v8 features: contractor claim + admin approval, contract PDF, Stripe deposit payments, review reminders. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed (test_v8_features.py) covering claim state machine, my-contractor, /admin/claims + approve action, PUT profile access control, PDF (application/pdf + %PDF header + ?token= support + 401 unauth), deposit session creation (£720 = 30% of £2400, url starts with https://checkout.stripe.com/), /payments/status polling, /reminders + /dismiss-review, and contractor review reply. Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844): fresh contractor signup with role=contractor OK; profile-contractor-hub link visible; admin login + admin dashboard + profile-admin link visible; Home 'review-reminder' banner rendered for garden_test; Projects tab 'open-agreements' row shows '2 to review' badge; contract detail page shows both download-pdf and pay-deposit buttons for active signed contract; tapping pay-deposit successfully redirects to Stripe Checkout (cs_test_...) with deferred_intent[amount]=72000 gbp (=£720.00). Overall PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py contract_pdf accepts token via Query or Authorization header — good for expo web Linking.openURL usage where headers can't be attached.
start_deposit correctly gates on _fully_signed + numeric price; deposit_session_id persisted on contract; /payments/status is idempotent (only sets deposit_paid once). Solid.

ContractorProfileUpdate schema only exposes tagline/phone/location/postcode/services/coverage_miles — no 'about'/'bio' field. If the Hub UI advertises editing a bio, update the schema; current PUT silently drops unknown fields.
seed_data_creation: Created fresh contractor accounts (email testcontractor_<ts>@example.com, role=contractor) via /api/auth/register, plus test contracts on the claimed listing (TEST_v8 prefix). No prod data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 v8 features verified end-to-end. Stripe test-mode deposit reaches Checkout with correct GBP amount; return-flow (?deposit=success&session_id=) is handled by /api/payments/status which flips deposit_paid=true — this was not driven through the Stripe Checkout UI in Playwright (blocked by 3rd-party) but was verified via /api/payments/status endpoint response shape. If needed, a follow-up run can simulate the redirect by manually invoking /api/payments/status/{session_id} after paying via a headed Stripe test session.
